title: vitex negundo var. incisa
intro: Vitex negundo var. incisa, commonly known as Chastetree or Five-Leaf Chaste Tree, is a plant species from the Verbenaceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiviral properties, which are said to help alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps, anxiety, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Vitex negundo var. incisa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer activities. The plant's leaves and flowers have been used in Ayurvedic and traditional Chinese medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being.
